input: Book a backstage tour at the local theater

gold.taskTitle: Book a Backstage Tour at the Local Theater
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange a backstage tour at a theater in their local area.

questions.title: Which specific theater are you targeting for this tour?
questions.description: Identify the exact theater by name and location so contact and booking details can be found.

questions.title: What date do you want the tour to take place?
questions.description: Pinpoint the preferred date to check availability and plan around it.

questions.title: How many people will be joining the tour?
questions.description: Determine group size, as this may affect booking type, pricing, and logistics.

questions.title: Is this tour for a personal, educational, or professional purpose?
questions.description: Understand the context and intent behind the tour to tailor the approach.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred time of day for the visit?
questions.description: Establish a time preference so it can be matched to the theater's available slots.

questions.title: Have you already contacted this theater about tours before?
questions.description: Determine whether prior contact has been made to avoid duplication and build on existing information.

questions.title: Is there a maximum budget you are willing to pay?
questions.description: Clarify any financial constraints so options can be filtered accordingly.
